description: Anchor a 32-byte hash to Base + Solana mainnet in parallel. Returns both tx URLs as cryptographic proof of when the hash existed. $0.005 USDC.

data.description: Arbitrary JSON to be canonicalized + SHA-256'd by the server. Mutually exclusive with `hash`.
data.title: Data

hash.description: Pre-computed 32-byte hex hash (64 chars, no 0x prefix). Mutually exclusive with `data`.
hash.title: Hash

note.description: Optional 200-char note included in the response (not on-chain).
note.title: Note

name: anchor_hash
title: anchor
